shortcuts.action: Show descriptions of error or warning at caret
Decrease current selection to previous state
Duplicate current line or selected block
Toggle case for word at caret or selected
Go back to previous tool window
Select current file or symbol in any view
Inspect current file with current profile
Switch between tabs and tool window

shortcuts.note: 展开 for(let i = 0; i < n; i++) { }；var/let/const 由变量 VARKIND 选择
展开 for (const 变量 of 可迭代对象) { }
展开 for (const 变量 in 对象) { }，拿到的是键/下标
与 forof 展开相同：for (const 变量 of 数组) { }
展开 for await (const 变量 of 对象) { }，用于异步迭代器
与 forin 展开相同：for (const 变量 in 对象) { }
展开 for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) { const 元素 = arr[i]; }
展开 for (let i = arr.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const 元素 = arr[i]; }
展开 console.log(); 光标在括号内
展开 console.trace(); 打印调用栈
展开 console.assert(); 条件为假时才输出
展开 define(["依赖"], function(依赖) { });
展开 const 名称 = () => { 选中内容 };
展开 import {成员} from "模块";
展开 import * as 别名 from "模块";
展开 import 名称 from "模块";
展开 export {成员} from "模块";
